summary: Member backup dispatch no longer holds the pool's backup slot, members follow a re-registered repository's name and credential reference, and two credential refusals say what to do.

guide.reason: Operators see the new refusal texts, member convergence and the 10 minute never-started failure.

api.reason: POST /api/v1/pools/{id}/backup-repositories keeps its shape; only a refusal text, member probe behaviour and the failure of a never-started member run changed. No new field or endpoint.

roadmap.reason: Bug fixes; no milestone or acceptance gate changes.

state.record: pool-backup-repositories.json on each host (master authoritative) and the pool backup run records on the master.
state.reason: No new state. A member's repository record is refreshed from the master by the existing access probe; a fresh Controller reads the same inventory.

verification.method: Focused Go tests in internal/agent with in-process hosts and an S3 fake; each new test was run against the unfixed code and failed. No lab run.
